### Wounds and Scars
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/day-by-day-oct-17-2007-11556960.html
Passage: Job 24:12
Points:
- Beneath the busy activity of daily life, many carry deep, unspoken inner pain.
- Soul wounds frequently stem from unfair treatment, misunderstandings, or hurtful remarks by trusted people.
- Guilt and lingering memories of past sins can leave tender emotional wounds and fear of rejection.
- Enduring hardship and hidden pain reminds believers of their fundamental need for one another and for God.
- Christ meets sufferers as the Great Physician who can turn painful wounds into scars of beauty.

### Rebellion to Restoration
Author: Margaret D. Mitchell
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/a-womans-walk/rebellion-to-restoration-god-s-love-at-work-week-of-august-31.html
Passage: Job 24:13
Points:
- Rebelling against the light is driven by pride, self-reliance, and an underlying fear of lack.
- Withholding the heart from God disrupts spiritual peace and damages personal relationships.
- Lasting restoration requires bringing hidden fears into the light and submitting fully to Christ.
- Exercising spiritual patience counters the urge to rebel while waiting on God's timing.
- The Lord promises to heal divided hearts and lead His people into renewed trust and deliverance.
